lessons.title: Dihydropyridine vs non-DHP
lessons.body: Amlodipine preferentially relaxes arteries. That helps blood pressure but can increase capillary pressure in the legs — educational framing for ankle oedema counselling.

lessons.title: Adherence beats perfection
lessons.body: Missed doses and sudden stops matter. Materia does not publish numeric regimens here — confirm against the labelled product and the clinician's plan.

quiz.prompt: A patient on amlodipine reports new ankle swelling. Best first educational frame?
choices: It means the medicine is not working — stop immediately
Peripheral oedema can occur with dihydropyridine CCBs — escalate to the clinician; do not invent a dose change
quiz.teachFromMiss: Ankle oedema is a known CCB counselling point — refer clinically; Materia never invents dose changes.
